title: Crypt
summary: Rust escrow template and CLI for encrypted secret sales on Ootle, with a wallet-free WebAssembly browser demo. On October 19, 2026, the demo accepted real BUY, OPEN and DISPUTE clicks and reached The Forger’s Curse locally; this did not submit a network transaction. Disputes reveal the secret publicly, and the contract checks delivery against the seller’s commitment, not its value. Sale metadata, amounts and funding links remain public. The maintainer supplies Esmeralda transaction evidence separately; historical same-wallet funding is not proof of independent counterparties. BSD-3-Clause source at 242f11b. Earlier source-only availability observations remain in the maintenance history.
cardSummary: Play a wallet-free secret-trading demo, choosing honest or deceptive actions to explore escrow and delivery disputes.
